_about: Q5 (WORK_QUEUE, 30 Oct 2026; unreleased): the vibration system plays (hits by damage share, shield vs hull, shield fail, the autopilot's hand-back pulse, popup confirmation request) under the Rumble row; and the advanced row pad_backend (0 XInput, 1 SDL3 experimental: PlayStation and Switch Pro pads with their own glyphs). Read live each frame (modules/controller/src/impl/gamepad.cpp).

rumble.help: Vibration strength: your ship being hit (heavier for hull than shield), your shield failing, the autopilot handing the ship back, and a game box waiting for your answer. 0 = off. Never the only cue. Silent while the game is in the background, paused (except those boxes), in menus and cutscenes, and while you play with keyboard and mouse.

rows.label: Controller backend
rows.help: How the controller is read. XInput (default): Xbox pads and pads that act as one. SDL3 (experimental): also PlayStation and Switch Pro pads, with their own button prompts, and the Xbox pad through SDL; if SDL cannot start, XInput keeps reading the pad. Not yet tested with real PlayStation or Switch pads.
